Overview:
We are looking for a versatile Developer/Researcher to help design, build, and evaluate decentralized applications (dApps). The role combines hands-on development with research into emerging technologies, protocols, and best practices in the Web3 ecosystem.

Collaborate with team members across engineering, product, and strategy.

Strong understanding of blockchain fundamentals (Ethereum, EVM, or other L1/L2s).
Experience with Solidity, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Web3 libraries.

Ability to analyze technical papers, protocols, and open-source projects.
Curiosity and willingness to learn in a fast-evolving field.
Nice to Have:
Experience contributing to open-source blockchain projects.
Knowledge of cryptography, token economics, or zero-knowledge proofs.
Background in both academic research and software development.
